name: Murloc Thieves
summary: Saria Fairmoon seeks the Memory Crystal carried by Razorgill near the Tower of Eldara. The glowing relic may hold Highborne history and arcane power.

sections.title: A Glowing Relic
sections.body: On the beaches of Azshara's northern peninsula, Saria Fairmoon spotted a large orange murloc carrying a glowing crystal near the Tower of Eldara. She believes the Highborne used such crystals to store history and memories, and that it could hold untold arcane power. Take the cliff route west of her camp to recover the Memory Crystal from Razorgill.

faq.answer: Saria Fairmoon in Azshara asks you to bring her the Memory Crystal.
Razorgill has the Memory Crystal near the Tower of Eldara.
Saria believes the Memory Crystal is a glowing Highborne relic used to store history and memories, and that it could hold arcane power.

faq.q: What is strange about the crystal?
faq.answer: The Memory Crystal has clamoring voices that Saria finds curious and alluring.
